children.text: Conversation 1: Rehearsal and Ride
children.cn: 对话1：排练与接送

children.text: Rehearsal Plans
children.cn: 排练计划

children.text: Hello?
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 喂？
children.statement: 这是打电话时的常用语。

children.text: Hi Dad, I have a rehearsal after school.
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 嗨爸爸，我放学后有排练。
children.statement: Jim 放学后没有事情。

children.text: Can you pick me up later?
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 你能晚点接我吗？
children.statement: Jim 请求爸爸晚点接他。
children.explanation: 句子表达了 Jim 的请求。

children.text: Sure.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 当然。
children.statement: 爸爸拒绝了 Jim。

children.text: When does it end?
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 它什么时候结束？
children.statement: 爸爸询问结束时间。

children.text: Timing and Conditions
children.cn: 时间与条件

children.text: We'll finish at 7:00 p.m. if it's on time.
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 如果准时的话，我们将在晚上7点结束。
children.statement: 这句话包含一个 if 条件句。
children.explanation: if 引导条件状语从句。

children.text: Can you pick me up at 7:15?
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 你能在7点15分接我吗？
children.statement: Jim 想让爸爸7点15分接他。

children.text: OK.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 好的。
children.statement: 爸爸同意了时间。

children.text: If everything goes well, I'll see you at 7:15.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 如果一切顺利，我将在7点15分见你。
children.statement: 爸爸使用了 if 来假设顺利的情况。

children.text: If the traffic is too bad, you'll have to wait for a few minutes.
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 如果交通太糟糕，你得等几分钟。
children.statement: 交通不好时 Jim 需要等待。
children.explanation: 句子表达了交通不好的后果。

children.text: Got it.
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 知道了。
children.statement: Jim 表示听懂了。

children.text: I'll wait for you at the school gate.
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 我会在学校门口等你。
children.statement: Jim 会在校门口等爸爸。

children.text: Bye!
children.speaker: Jim
children.cn: 再见！
children.statement: 对话结束时 Jim 道别。

children.text: Bye!
children.speaker: Dad
children.cn: 再见！
children.statement: 爸爸也回复了再见。

children.text: Conversation 2: Video Call to Grandpa
children.cn: 对话2：给爷爷的视频电话

children.text: Video Call Start
children.cn: 视频通话开始

children.text: Grandpa, can you see me?
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 爷爷，你能看见我吗？
children.statement: Emma 在确认爷爷是否能看到她。

children.text: Welcome to People's Park!
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 欢迎来到人民公园！
children.statement: Emma 在人民公园给爷爷打电话。

children.text: Let me use the camera to show you around.
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 让我用摄像头带你参观一下。
children.statement: Emma 要用摄像头带爷爷云旅游。

children.text: Hello!
children.speaker: Grandpa
children.cn: 喂！
children.statement: 爷爷接听了电话并打招呼。

children.text: Yes, I can see you and the park.
children.speaker: Grandpa
children.cn: 是的，我能看到你和公园。
children.statement: 爷爷能看到 Emma 和公园。
children.explanation: 爷爷肯定了 Emma 的问题。

children.text: Park Activities and Future Plans
children.cn: 公园活动与未来计划

children.text: Oh, people are singing and dancing.
children.speaker: Grandpa
children.cn: 哦，人们在唱歌跳舞。
children.notes: singing and dancing = 唱歌跳舞
children.statement: 爷爷看到了人们在唱歌跳舞。
children.explanation: 句子描述了公园的景象。

children.text: They seem happy.
children.speaker: Grandpa
children.cn: 他们看起来很高兴。
children.statement: 爷爷觉得人们看起来很高兴。

children.text: Yeah.
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 是的。
children.statement: Emma 同意爷爷的看法。

children.text: Many people come here to exercise and relax.
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 很多人来这里锻炼和放松。
children.statement: 人们来公园是为了锻炼和放松。

children.text: If I visit China this year, I will go to the park with you.
children.speaker: Grandpa
children.cn: 如果我今年访问中国，我会和你一起去这个公园。
children.statement: 爷爷表达了如果去中国就去公园的愿望。

children.text: It seems fun and lively.
children.speaker: Grandpa
children.cn: 这看起来很有趣很热闹。
children.notes: lively = 热闹的、充满活力的
children.statement: 爷爷觉得公园很热闹。
children.explanation: lively 描述了公园的氛围。

children.text: Great!
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 太好了！
children.statement: Emma 听到爷爷的话觉得很高兴。

children.text: If you can make it, I'll show you around the city and let you taste all the yummy local food.
children.speaker: Emma
children.cn: 如果你能成行，我会带你参观这座城市，并让你品尝所有美味的当地食物。
children.notes: make it = 成行、做成；local = 当地的
children.statement: Emma 承诺爷爷成行后带他吃美食和逛城市。

children.text: Wonderful!
children.speaker: Grandpa
children.cn: 太精彩了！
children.statement: 爷爷觉得这个计划棒极了。

children.text: Communication Problems and Face-to-Face
children.cn: 沟通问题与面对面交流

children.text: Professor, thanks for the helpful speech on communication.
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 教授，谢谢你关于沟通的有益演讲。
children.statement: Jason 感谢教授的演讲。

children.text: I have a question.
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 我有一个问题。
children.statement: Jason 接下来要提问。
children.explanation: I have a question 意为我有问题。

children.text: Sometimes my friends and I argue but don't know how to make up.
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 有时候我和朋友们争吵，却不知道如何言归于好。
children.notes: argue = 争吵；make up = 言归于好
children.statement: Jason 和朋友吵架后不知道怎么和好。
children.explanation: argue 和 make up 解释了问题所在。

children.text: What's the best way to communicate in this situation?
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 在这种情况下，最好的沟通方式是什么？
children.statement: Jason 在询问最佳沟通方法。

children.text: If you want to solve the problem, a face-to-face talk usually works the best.
children.speaker: Professor
children.cn: 如果你想解决问题，面对面的谈话通常效果最好。
children.notes: solve = 解决；face-to-face = 面对面的
children.statement: 教授认为面对面谈话是最好的解决方法。

children.text: Alternatives and Texting Risks
children.cn: 替代方案与发短信的风险

children.text: I understand, but meeting in person is not always easy.
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 我明白，但亲自见面并不总是容易的。
children.statement: Jason 觉得当面见面有困难。
children.explanation: not always easy 表示并非总是容易。

children.text: If you can't meet, just call your friend.
children.speaker: Professor
children.cn: 如果你不能见面，就给你的朋友打电话。
children.statement: 教授建议不能见面时打电话。

children.text: Some of you may prefer texting, but it takes longer and can make things worse if you're not careful with your words.
children.speaker: Professor
children.cn: 你们中的一些人可能更喜欢发短信，但如果不注意措辞，它会花费更长时间并让事情变得更糟糕。
children.notes: prefer = 更喜欢；worse = 更糟糕的
children.statement: 发短信不小心的话可能会使事情变糟。
children.explanation: 包含 if 条件句和转折连词 but。

children.text: But what if we argue more over the phone?
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 但是如果我们通过电话吵得更厉害怎么办？
children.notes: over the phone = 通过电话
children.statement: Jason 担心打电话会吵得更凶。
children.explanation: What if 表达假设担忧。

children.text: Calming Down and Conclusion
children.cn: 冷静与总结

children.text: If you stay calm and say sorry, it will help.
children.speaker: Professor
children.cn: 如果你保持冷静并道歉，会有帮助的。
children.notes: calm = 冷静的；say sorry = 道歉
children.statement: 保持冷静和道歉会有帮助。

children.text: If it is still hard to talk, take a break.
children.speaker: Professor
children.cn: 如果还是很难交谈，就休息一下。
children.notes: take a break = 休息一下
children.statement: 难沟通时可以先休息一下。
children.keywords: hard to talk, take a break

children.text: Meet when you're both ready.
children.speaker: Professor
children.cn: 等你们俩都准备好了再见面。
children.statement: 教授建议双方都准备好再见面。

children.text: I'll call and try to meet.
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 我会打电话并尽量去见面的。
children.statement: Jason 决定打电话并尝试见面。
children.explanation: 表达了 Jason 的行动决心。

children.text: Because friendship is important.
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 因为友谊很重要。
children.statement: Jason 认为友谊很重要。

children.text: Thanks for the advice!
children.speaker: Jason
children.cn: 谢谢你的建议！
children.statement: Jason 感谢教授的建议。

children.text: You're welcome.
children.speaker: Professor
children.cn: 不客气。
children.statement: 教授礼貌地回答不客气。
children.explanation: You're welcome 用于回应感谢。

tree.text: How to Make a Better Conversation

children.text: Introduction and Worries
children.cn: 引言与担忧

children.text: Do you get nervous when you talk to someone?
children.cn: 当你和某人说话时你会紧张吗？
children.statement: 文章开头用问句引发读者思考。
children.explanation: Do you... 引导一般疑问句。

children.text: Do you find it hard to have a conversation with a stranger?
children.cn: 你觉得和陌生人交谈很难吗？
children.statement: 很多人觉得和陌生人交谈很难。

children.text: If you have such worries, it is time for you to learn some more conversation skills.
children.cn: 如果你有这样的担忧，是时候学习更多交谈技巧了。
children.statement: 有这种担忧时需要学习交谈技巧。

children.text: Here are some tips for making better conversations.
children.cn: 这里有一些进行更好对话的建议。
children.statement: 文章接下来会给出对话建议。
children.explanation: Here are... 用于引出下文。

children.text: Four Conversation Tips
children.cn: 四项对话技巧

children.text: Tip 1: Listen Carefully and Show Interest
children.cn: 技巧1：认真倾听并表现出兴趣

children.text: Listen carefully and show interest in others.
children.cn: 认真倾听并对他人表现出兴趣。
children.notes: show interest in = 对……表现出兴趣
children.statement: 这是第一条对话技巧的核心主旨句。
children.explanation: 祈使句作为段落小标题/主旨句。

children.text: One of the most important things is to listen to the person you speak to.
children.cn: 最重要的事情之一就是倾听和你说话的人。
children.statement: 倾听是对话中最重要的事情之一。

children.text: If you are a good listener, you will find some good points to ask questions about.
children.cn: 如果你是一个好的倾听者，你会发现一些好的切入点来提问。
children.notes: listener = 听者；point = 观点、要点
children.statement: 好听众能找到提问的好切入点。

children.text: For example, if someone tells you their hobby and you can ask questions about it, they will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
children.cn: 例如，如果有人告诉你他们的爱好，你可以就此提问，他们一定会高兴地继续对话。
children.notes: for example = 例如；hobby = 爱好
children.statement: 询问对方的爱好能让对方高兴地继续聊天。
children.explanation: 包含 for example 和 if 条件句。

children.text: Tip 2: Choose the Right Topic
children.cn: 技巧2：选择合适的话题

children.text: Choose the right topic.
children.cn: 选择合适的话题。
children.statement: 这是第二条对话技巧的主旨句。

children.text: Some of the best topics might be the weather, sports, music, films, food, or travel.
children.cn: 一些最好的话题可能是天气、体育、音乐、电影、食物或旅行。
children.statement: 天气、运动等是很好的对话话题。

children.text: However, it is impolite to ask someone's age, weight, or other personal information.
children.cn: 然而，询问某人的年龄、体重或其他个人信息是不礼貌的。
children.notes: impolite = 不礼貌的；personal = 个人的
children.statement: 打听别人年龄体重是不礼貌的。

children.text: Also, if you don't agree with others, don't argue with others.
children.cn: 另外，如果你不同意别人的观点，不要和他们争论。
children.notes: agree with = 同意；argue = 争论
children.statement: 不同意别人时不要争论。
children.explanation: 包含 if 条件句和并列词 also。

children.text: Just move on to another topic.
children.cn: 换到另一个话题就行了。
children.statement: 可以转移话题来避免争论。

children.text: Tip 3: Be Honest and Sincere
children.cn: 技巧3：真诚坦率

children.text: Be honest and sincere.
children.cn: 做到诚实和真诚。
children.notes: honest = 诚实的；sincere = 真诚的
children.statement: 这是第三条对话技巧的主旨句。
children.explanation: 祈使句强调真诚的态度。

children.text: If you have no idea of a subject, just say "I don't know much about it."
children.cn: 如果你对某个主题一无所知，就说“我对此了解不多”。
children.statement: 对某事不了解时可以直接坦诚说明。

children.text: If you want to make the other person happy, mention his or her strong points.
children.cn: 如果你想让对方高兴，提一提他或她的长处。
children.statement: 夸奖对方长处能让对方高兴。

children.text: But don't just pretend to be nice, because people can find out you are not telling the truth.
children.cn: 但是不要只是假装友善，因为人们能发现你没说实话。
children.notes: pretend = 假装；find out = 弄清、发现
children.statement: 假装友善会被人发现。
children.explanation: 包含转折连词 but 和原因连词 because。

children.text: Tip 4: Pay Attention to Body Language
children.cn: 技巧4：注意肢体语言

children.text: Pay attention to your body language.
children.cn: 注意你的肢体语言。
children.notes: pay attention to = 注意；body language = 肢体语言
children.statement: 这是第四条对话技巧的主旨句。
children.explanation: 祈使句引导第四条技巧。

children.text: Sometimes it is just as important as your words.
children.cn: 有时它和你的话语一样重要。
children.statement: 肢体语言和说话同样重要。
children.explanation: as... as 同级比较结构。

children.text: Don't be nervous.
children.cn: 不要紧张。
children.statement: 文章建议不要紧张。

children.text: Stand up straight, smile, and be yourself—you have a lot to offer.
children.cn: 站直，微笑，做你自己——你有很多可以给予的。
children.notes: stand up straight = 站直；be yourself = 做你自己
children.statement: 要站直、微笑并做自己。

children.text: Conclusion
children.cn: 结论

children.text: If you really work at it, you will find having conversations much easier.
children.cn: 如果你真的为此努力，你会发现交谈容易得多。
children.statement: 努力练习会使对话变得容易。

children.text: Social Media Reality and Risks
children.cn: 社交媒体的现状与风险

children.text: No matter whether you like it or not, social media is becoming a big part of many teenagers' lives.
children.cn: 不管你喜不喜欢，社交媒体正在成为许多青少年生活的大部分。
children.notes: no matter whether = 无论是否；teenager = 青少年
children.statement: 社交媒体成了青少年生活的重要部分。
children.explanation: No matter whether 引导让步状语从句。

children.text: The internet is popular among young people in China.
children.cn: 互联网在中国年轻人中很受欢迎。
children.statement: 互联网在中国年轻人中很流行。
children.explanation: popular among 表示在……中受欢迎。

children.text: According to a survey by the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, over 90 per cent of all Chinese minors use the internet and 50 per cent of these young people have made new friends online.
children.cn: 根据共青团中央的一项调查，超过90%的中国未成年人使用互联网，其中50%的年轻人在线结交了新朋友。
children.notes: survey = 调查；minor = 未成年人
children.statement: 九成以上中国未成年人使用互联网。
children.explanation: According to 引导介词短语作状语。

children.text: Social media allows people to connect with friends, share experiences, and stay on trend.
children.cn: 社交媒体允许人们与朋友联系、分享经验并保持潮流。
children.notes: connect with = 与……联系；experience = 经验
children.statement: 社交媒体有连接朋友和分享经验的作用。
children.explanation: allow sb to do sth 结构。

children.text: However, the internet also has risks.
children.cn: 然而，互联网也有风险。
children.statement: 互联网除了好处也有风险。

children.text: It is important to stay safe while having fun online.
children.cn: 在网上玩得开心的同时保持安全是很重要的。
children.statement: 上网时保持安全很重要。
children.explanation: It is important to do 结构。

children.text: Here are some simple tips.
children.cn: 这里有一些简单的建议。
children.statement: 下文会给出上网安全的简单建议。

children.text: Four Online Safety Tips
children.cn: 四项网络安全建议

children.text: Tip 1: Strong Passwords
children.cn: 建议1：使用强密码

children.text: First, if you have accounts on different apps, make sure you use strong passwords.
children.cn: 首先，如果你在不同的应用程序上有账号，确保你使用强密码。
children.statement: 不同应用账号要使用强密码。
children.explanation: 包含 if 条件句和顺序词 First。

children.text: Avoid using easy-to-guess information, like your birthday or your pet's name.
children.cn: 避免使用容易猜到的信息，比如你的生日或宠物名字。
children.statement: 不要用生日或宠物名作密码。

children.text: Tip 2: Careful with Strangers & Personal Details
children.cn: 建议2：警惕陌生人与个人隐私

children.text: Second, be careful when you talk to strangers online.
children.cn: 第二，在网上和陌生人说话时要小心。
children.statement: 网上和陌生人交流要小心。
children.explanation: 包含顺序词 Second 和时间连词 when。

children.text: Not every person online is friendly or telling the truth about themselves.
children.cn: 网上的每个人不都是友好的或者说关于他们自己的实话。
children.statement: 网上的人并非个个都友好或说实话。

children.text: Don't share personal details, like your address, school name, or phone number.
children.cn: 不要分享个人细节，比如你的地址、学校名称或电话号码。
children.statement: 不要泄露个人地址和电话等细节。

children.text: Tip 3: Think Before Posting
children.cn: 建议3：发帖前三思

children.text: Third, if you want to post anything online, think it over.
children.cn: 第三，如果你想在网上发任何东西，仔细考虑一下。
children.notes: post = 发布；think over = 仔细考虑
children.statement: 发帖前要仔细考虑。
children.explanation: 包含顺序词 Third 和 if 条件句。

children.text: Once it is out there, it is hard to know who sees it.
children.cn: 一旦它发出去了，很难知道谁会看到它。
children.statement: 发出去的内容很难知道谁看过。
children.explanation: Once 引导条件状语从句。

children.text: Don't talk about things you may regret.
children.cn: 不要谈论你可能会后悔的事情。
children.statement: 不要谈论可能后悔的事。
children.explanation: 否定祈使句加定语从句。

children.text: Tip 4: Keep Profiles Private
children.cn: 建议4：保持资料私密

children.text: Lastly, keep your social media profiles private so only real friends can see your posts and information.
children.cn: 最后，保持你的社交媒体资料私密，这样只有真正的朋友才能看到你的动态和信息。
children.notes: profile = 个人资料；private = 私密的
children.statement: 要将社交账号设为私密，只让真朋友看见。
children.explanation: 包含 Lastly 和表目的的 so that 结构简化版。

children.text: Conclusion and Advice
children.cn: 总结与忠告

children.text: Remember, by following these tips, you can stay safe on social media and the internet.
children.cn: 记住，通过遵循这些建议，你可以在社交媒体和互联网上保持安全。
children.statement: 遵循这些建议能保证上网安全。

children.text: Your parents and teachers want the best for you.
children.cn: 你的父母和老师希望你一切都好。
children.notes: want the best for = 希望……最好
children.statement: 父母和老师都希望你好。

children.text: Be aware of the risks and protect yourself.
children.cn: 意识到风险并保护自己。
children.notes: be aware of = 意识到；protect = 保护
children.statement: 要意识到风险并自我保护。
